known_differences.description: fsci-spatial implements KDTree, pdist/cdist distance metrics, Rotation/Slerp, Procrustes, and 2D/nD ConvexHull/Delaunay/Voronoi.

threats.description: Degenerate or collinear point sets in Procrustes and Delaunay triangulation causing singular transformations or predicate flips.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-spatial/src/lib.rs:6615 (procrustes): checks zero-norm / degenerate point configurations and rejects or regularizes before SVD alignment.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SpatialError on degenerate zero-variance point sets matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject degenerate geometry fail-closed and record FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Mismatched vector dimensions, empty point clouds, or non-finite coordinates passed to euclidean / pdist / cdist.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-spatial/src/lib.rs:157 (euclidean): validates equal vector lengths and finite coordinates before computing norms.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite coordinates and dimension mismatches fail-closed.

threats.description: High-dimensional geometric predicate allocations in n-D hull/Delaunay exceeding safe kernel dimension limits.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-spatial/src/lib.rs:862 (pdist): guards allocation sizes and rejects oversized geometric dimensions before predicate scratch allocation.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SpatialError when dimension exceeds supported predicate limit.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject oversized dimension before allocation and log FailClosed event.

threats.description: Batch cdist / KDTree radius queries diverging from single-query tie-breaking and distance metrics.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-spatial/src/lib.rs:1735 (cdist): uses shared metric dispatch and verified batch kernels matching scalar reference.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy cdist and KDTree query outputs across metrics.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate metric parameters (e.g., Minkowski p >= 1) fail-closed.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: vector dimension mismatch in distance metrics
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SpatialError::DimensionMismatch and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject non-finite KDTree and hull inputs.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject all non-finite spatial inputs and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: oversized geometric dimension for exact predicates
fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return SpatialError before allocating predicate workspace.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SpatialError and log FailClosed event.
